basic_info.description: This rare offering with over 4,400 square feet of recently remodeled living space, is designed to meet the demands of modern life, offering generous room to work, entertain, and unwind. The main level features an open-concept layout anchored by a dramatic living room and an ocean view deck. The living room flows seamlessly into a formal dining space designed for hosting. The remodeled chef's kitchen is the heart of the home, with a large island, high-end appliances, a lounge area, and direct access to a second deck for grilling. All four spacious bedrooms, including the primary suite, are located on one levelalong with a large laundry room. The primary suite is a true retreat with a walk-in closet, spa-like bath and ocean and city views. Downstairs, a versatile bonus level includes a large multipurpose roomideal as a media room, guest suite, or private office with separate entrance and yard access. The private backyard patio is perfect for kids, pets, or weekend lounging. An outdoor shower makes cleanup easy after beach excursions. Located across the street from the Lands End trailhead and Lincoln Park Golf Course, and just blocks from China Beach and Golden Gate Park, 3749 Clement offers the scale of a suburban home with the best of San Francisco living at your doorstep.
